name: read_access_group_project
description:
Get a project that belongs to an access group, identified by access group ID or name and project ID. Returns the project's membership in that group.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/access-groups/{accessGroupIdOrName}/projects/{projectId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
